name: Aegenelles no Hanayome
source:
Main character is a crown prince of a small kingdom. Parents choose a suitable candidate who he never even seen in real life. In opposition to this decision prince swears to find a girl to love himself in the castle town. It's three weeks before coronation and wedding ceremony...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-september-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一个小王国的王储。父母替他选定了一位合适的结婚对象，而他甚至从未亲眼见过对方。为了反抗这项决定，王子发誓要亲自在城下町找到心爱的少女。距离加冕与婚礼只剩三周…

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-september-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
